title: Cytotoxicity Profile of Schiff Base Organotin(IV) Complexes: Experimental and Theoretical Approach.
authors: Kaur, Manpreet; Sood, Kritika; Yempally, Veeranna; Kaur, Harminder
one_liner_zh: 该文研究席夫碱有机锡配合物的合成、细胞毒性与DNA结合，虽含分子对接和DNA结合实验，但核心为金属配合物抗癌活性，非TF-DNA互作体系，方法深度有限。
abstract: Present work deals with the synthesis, characterization and biological investigation of Schiff base ((E)N'(2,3-dihydroxybenzylidene)isonicotinohydrazide (L)) and its diorganotin(IV) complexes (R(2)SnL, diphenyltin(IV) complex R = Ph (1), dimethyltin(IV) complex R = Me(2))by experimental and theoretical approach. All the complexes were characterized by spectroscopic techniques including FTIR, multinuclear NMR and theoretical studies. Theoretical calculations were carried out using Gaussian 09 software which also supports the experimental analysis. Molecular docking studies using Autodock software were carried out to predict the binding pose and affinity of the complexes towards particular proteins. DNA binding studies by UV titrations and in-silico studies showed the superior binding of diphenyltin(IV) complex (1) and dimethyltin(IV) complex (2) in an intercalative mode. In- vitro cytotoxicity analysis of L and its complexes (1, 2) was carried out against two cancer cell lines using MTT assay. Diphenyltin(IV) complex (1) was more potent and cytotoxic against studied cancer cell lines i.e.C6 Glioblastoma cells and SH-SY5Y Neuroblastoma cells.
abstract_zh: 本工作通过实验与理论方法，研究了席夫碱（(E)N'(2,3-二羟基亚苄基)异烟肼（L））及其二有机锡(IV)配合物（R(2)SnL，二苯基锡(IV)配合物 R = Ph (1)，二甲基锡(IV)配合物 R = Me(2)）的合成、表征及生物活性。所有配合物均通过光谱技术（包括FTIR、多核NMR）及理论研究进行了表征。理论计算使用Gaussian 09软件进行，其结果也支持了实验分析。利用Autodock软件进行的分子对接研究，用于预测配合物对特定蛋白质的结合姿态和亲和力。通过紫外滴定和计算机模拟进行的DNA结合研究表明，二苯基锡(IV)配合物(1)和二甲基锡(IV)配合物(2)以嵌入模式表现出优越的结合能力。对L及其配合物(1, 2)的体外细胞毒性分析，使用MTT法针对两种癌细胞系进行。二苯基锡(IV)配合物(1)在所研究的癌细胞系（即C6胶质母细胞瘤细胞和SH-SY5Y神经母细胞瘤细胞）中表现出更强的效力和细胞毒性。
